sql:
with t as (select o.market_ticker, min(o.strategy) tag, count(distinct o.strategy) ntag from live_orders o join fills f on f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy in ('Fmmsell10','Hmmsell10','Jmmsell10') and o.action='buy' group by 1),
s as (select distinct on (p.market_ticker) p.market_ticker, coalesce(p.quantity_fp,p.quantity::numeric) q, p.realized_pnl r, p.avg_price a from positions p join t using(market_ticker) order by p.market_ticker, p.captured_at desc),
m as (select distinct on (k.market_ticker) k.market_ticker, k.no_bid from mmsell_position_ticks k join t using(market_ticker) where k.no_bid is not null order by k.market_ticker, k.captured_at desc)
select t.tag, case when t.market_ticker ~ '^(KXATP|KXWTA|KXITF)' then 'tennis' when t.market_ticker like 'KXBTCD%' then 'btcd' else 'other' end grp,
 count(*) filter (where s.q=0) settled, round(sum(s.r) filter (where s.q=0),2) realized,
 count(*) filter (where s.q=0 and s.r<0) losers,
 count(*) filter (where s.q<>0) open, round(sum(abs(s.q)*(m.no_bid - s.a)/100) filter (where s.q<>0),2) unrealized,
 round(sum(abs(s.q)*s.a/100) filter (where s.q<>0),2) open_cost,
 count(*) filter (where s.q<>0 and m.no_bid is null) unmarked, sum(case when t.ntag>1 then 1 else 0 end) shared
from t join s using(market_ticker) left join m using(market_ticker) group by 1,2 order by 1,2
